parts.name: Safety Interlock Switch - Swinging Door
parts.description: Safety interlock switch for swinging doors that includes a sensor, magnet and bracket. It provides a holding force of 112 lbs with power and has visible open/closed indicators.
features: Provides enhanced safety and compliance while optimizing overall machine efficiency in various industrial applications.
Includes sensor, magnet and bracket. Allows for flexible latching up to .10” away and forgiving alignment (tilt: (+-) 4° and lateral (+-) .20”).
Visible open/closed indicators
Holding force with power 112 lbs / without power 6.7 lbs
Rated IP65/67
parts.dimension_notes: M and R are hole diameters (ø M, ø R); sensor has an M12, 8 pin connection
parts.notes: Series badges printed: 15, 30, 40, 45 (one part fits all). M12, 8 pin connection. Suggested hardware listed is the row badged 15/40 (metric M5/M4 bolts with slide-in T-nuts).

parts.name: Counterbalance External Pulley Kit
parts.description: Counterbalance pulley kit with the counterweights housed external to the extrusion and a mounting bracket for fractional or metric framing. It has a 75 lb (34 kg) load rating for both sides of the pulley.
features: Counterweights housed external to extrusion
75 lb (34 kg) load rating for both sides of pulley
Mounting bracket allows connection to fractional or metric framing
Compact design enables cable to ride inside T-slot
Designed to pair with snap in conduit (PN 6354) and counterbalance weight
Easy counterbalance assembly when used with cable kit (PN 6353) and double T-slot bearing pad (PN 6352)
Requires end tap (M8 x 1.25 to attach mounting bracket)
parts.notes: Included kit parts: Counterbalance Housing (1), 2.50” Pulley (1), Mounting Bracket (1), M8 x 20mm FHSCS (1), M4 x 16mm SHCS (2), Shoulder Bolt, 1/4” Hex Drive (1), 3/8”-16 Hex Nut (1), 3/8” Washer (1). Required machining: Tap Profile End on the Mounting Profile (reference page 11-3), M8 x 1.25 end tap. Load rating 75 lb (34 kg). Pairs with snap in conduit 6354, cable kit 6353 and double T-slot bearing pad 6352. Series badges printed: 15, 40.

parts.name: Counterbalance Internal Pulley Kit
parts.description: Counterbalance pulley kit with the counterweights housed within the supporting profiles and a dual pulley design for left- or right-hand configurations. It has a 75 lb (34 kg) load rating for both sides of the pulley.
features: Counterweights housed within supporting profiles
75 lb (34 kg) load rating for both sides of pulley
Slotted mounting holes enable fractional or metric framing connections
Compact design enables cable to ride inside T-slot
Dual pulley design for left- or right-hand configurations
Easy counterbalance assembly when used with cable kit (PN 6353) and double T-slot bearing pad (PN 6352)
Requires two end taps (M8 x 1.25 to attach mounting block)
parts.notes: Included kit parts: Internal Counterbalance Housing (1), 2.00” Pulley (1), M8 x 25mm SHCS (2), Shoulder Bolt, 1/4” Hex Drive (1). Required machining: Tap Profile End on the Mounting Profile (reference page 11-3), two M8 x 1.25 end taps. Load rating 75 lb (34 kg). Pairs with cable kit 6353 and double T-slot bearing pad 6352. Series badges printed: 15, 40, 45; 45 series requires threaded inserts (PN 14196).
